purpose: Create pre-edit input candidates from fixed Mira targets for face, hair and whole-image style conversion LoRA. Generation runs in the reverse direction of training.
split_policy: No automatic selection. Preserve prior target split as reserved_split; all derivatives of a target must stay in the same split.
training_direction: reviewed non-Mira input -> original Mira target
review_checks: Face and hairstyle differ from Mira; full-image rendering style changes.
Match camera, perspective, framing, subject position and apparent body scale to the original target; reject zoom, recrop or viewpoint drift even if both images have the same direction label.
Pose, head direction, facial expression, framing, clothing design, scene objects and spatial layout correspond to target.
Reject unintended object removal/addition, changed pose/expression, anatomy defects or residual Mira identity.
Review original targets for a sufficiently consistent intended BFS style; prior identity acceptance does not automatically approve them for style conversion training.
